6025.title: Rejected extension events retain unbounded diagnostics
6025.rootCauseOneLine: All extension rejection paths copy the original payload into provider/unhandled data, bypassing the extension payload retention limit.
6025.proposedFix: Bound the shared rejection conversion, omit oversized payloads with their original UTF-8 byte count, and constrain diagnostic text. First decide how an absolute diagnostic budget interacts with exact, currently unbounded provenance identifiers.
6025.caveats: Same agent repeated the regression in a second clean checkout with fresh migrated SQLite databases and forced execution. Full reproduction patch and output are inline in the HTML, per reports repository policy. No production measurements or loading-time claims verified. No PR: an absolute cap with exact unbounded identity fields needs a product/protocol decision outside the simple-fix rule.
